tr.title: Grayscale Zcash ETF filing reignites privacy coin scrutiny
slides: Grayscale submits a Zcash ETF application to US regulators
The filing seeks approval for a publicly traded Zcash investment product
Regulators have previously rejected privacy coin ETF proposals due to compliance concerns
Grayscale aims to list the ETF on major exchanges if approved
tr.caption:
Grayscale has submitted a Zcash ETF application to the SEC
The filing could bring privacy coin exposure to mainstream markets
